title: Chapter 473
paragraphs: Chapter 473
132. Massacre, and Strange...(7)
Thud, Midor collapsed forward. Now, the only remaining members on Zipfel's side were Muron, Sandra, and seven elders.
"The matapju...!"
"Lord Midor!"
The elders shouted.
However, there was nothing they could do.
There were no hidden secret weapons left, nor any reliable means.
There was no way out. Whether they fought or not, only a future of death awaited them.
Then, it was right to fight valiantly and die in battle, but the elders could not move.
Looking at Jin, who was shining with an intense gaze beyond the black helmet, they felt as if they were being crushed by fear.
It wasn't just a feeling. In reality, the elders were struggling to withstand the energy Jin was emitting.
'Muron Zipfel.'
Jin turned his gaze to Muron.
It was then that Muron seemed to regain his senses. He stopped mumbling meaningless words out of fear, and his eyes found focus.
'I didn't think I'd see your disgusting face again.'
Jin thought so and suppressed his anger. He gritted his teeth as he recalled the atrocities Muron had committed in Colon, but he could not show that to him.
The daily lives of the Hongins with severed vocal cords by Muron were still filled with silence. The dead family members were not coming back.
Sigh...
Muron lowered his head, holding his forehead.
[Well, I've shown an embarrassing side of myself. I was so scared after being beaten up that I froze like a terrified dog.]
The fear that had just made him cry was gone, and Muron's eyes were now filled with madness.
[I didn't know you'd become such a great warrior, Jin Runcandel. Back then, even if all of you attacked me together, you couldn't stand a chance against me.]
Jin kept moving towards Muron without responding. He was reminded of one thing Muron had said in the past.

-Do you think I'm crazy? But Jin Runcandel, even though I can't see your face behind the helmet... it seems like you're wearing a pretty good expression. You're in the same category as me. You like fighting.
The words Muron spat out during a battle in Colon.
'You said that back then because you, Muron, looked down on me and thought you were in a position to acknowledge me.'
Jin had been observing Muron Zipfel as a person since then.
As a pureblood Zipfel, he lived in alcohol addiction every day, was called "The Madman of Matap," fell into disgrace, and expressed himself through extremely cruel acts.
All these actions stemmed from 'inferiority.'

The disappointment of not being able to become the head of the Zipfel family, the humiliation and jealousy felt towards his better siblings, and the bitter conviction that he could not establish himself as a true powerhouse.
If he couldn't raise his prestige, he wanted to shine through infamy.
That was Muyron's greatest desire. It was the only way for him to hide his inferiority complex from others and express it to himself.
A monster of the desire for recognition.
There was no better way to describe Muyron Zipfel in a single word. That's why Muyron always wanted people to talk about his name, and whenever he had the chance, he tried to "acknowledge" others.
By acknowledging others, it would become his own virtue.
The more wonderful and brilliant the opponent, the stronger this tendency became. Because acknowledging a shining person made him feel the most amazing and thrilling.
He gained the blind trust of Midor, who was ignored by everyone, since childhood, and even told Jin that they were in the same category. It was all in the same context.

[So, are you going to kill me now? Or torture me? Cooking me alive and feeding me to the Hongin insects you saved wouldn't be a bad punishment either. Do whatever you want, you're the winner this time anyway...]
None of this could be a punishment for Muyron.
No matter how brutally he was killed, no matter how painfully he was tortured, Muyron would eventually grasp a victory of his own.
He would think that he had dominated Jin's mind. He would believe that he had controlled Jin to hate him.
Knowing this fact all too well, he deliberately didn't say a single word to Muyron, who had just regained his senses.
[Ah, was it Tika? Is that rat-like girl who ruined our show alive? If it wasn't for that, the situation would have been a bit more...]
Muyron stopped talking.
His eyes, which had just regained focus, began to tremble rapidly. And that was for no other reason.
Because Jin simply passed by him.
[...Where are you going, Jin Runcandel?]
Now, Zipfel had lost the value of death.
As long as there was a means of resurrection, death could not make Zipfel afraid in most situations.
Especially for someone like Muyron.
That's why Jin chose the most effective punishment for him.
Pride.
Stripping off the layers of falsehood that decorated his worthless self.
[Where are you going, answer meeeeee!]
He couldn't help but chuckle after passing Muyron by about ten steps.
Naturally, Muyron raged like a madman, unable to hear the laughter.
[Stop, stop, I said stop!]
Ciiiing!
A dark flame formed in Muyron's eyes.
The Zipfel's elemental magic, Blue Eye of Cheonghwa, which he had used in Colon as well.
Back then, it was a spell that couldn't do anything to Jin, an aspiring rider. It was immediately extinguished by Tess's real blue flame.

And back then, Muyron thought this while watching Jin summon Tess. So, that pitiful creature really received Tess's choice and became the wizard who would rule the era, the greatest wizard that even Muyron dared not dream of!
As memories from that time surfaced, it felt like something had exploded in his head. He wanted to die right away, consumed by the shame and inferiority that stabbed at the back of his neck.
Screeeeech…!
Following Myu-ron's gaze, the blue flames of the Cheonghwa's Mana rose on Jin's back.
However, the flames of the Mana kept extinguishing powerlessly without leaving even a small trace of burn on the spiritual armor.
The spiritual armor was a part of the enhanced Bradamante, which contained a part of Tess.
Therefore, Myu-ron's Mana couldn't inflict any damage on Jin. Despite it being the most powerful technique he could use, aside from dark magic.
[Burn, die, burn and die, or kill me...! Stop it!]
The true face of inferiority is so ugly.

In this situation, most of those watching Myu-ron were too embarrassed to even open their eyes. Even though they were all flustered by the chaos that had just taken place, they were agonized by Myu-ron's ugliness.
Some even went beyond embarrassment to feel pity and sympathy. They couldn't help but cluck their tongues at his terrible wretchedness.
Whoosh, hiss...!
In the end, the Cheonghwa's Mana that Myu-ron unleashed didn't leave a single trace on Jin's spiritual armor, even though he kept pouring it out until his magic power ran out and the backflow began.
With disheveled hair and gasping for breath, Myu-ron's bloodshot eyes streamed with bloody tears.
What he saw in his reddened vision was none other than the majestic Black Dragon.
And the awe-struck royal knights, the few remaining elders of Zipfel, Kinzelo's retainers, and the knights of Runcandel.
In the middle of them all, the steel-like back of the man who had just walked past him.
That seemed like a symbol to Myu-ron. It seemed as if all four major powers were looking up to Jin...
'You've already... grasped the era...!'
Cough!
Suddenly, Myu-ron coughed up blood and buckled at the waist. The backflow of magic power had begun.
He kept choking and coughing, blood gushing from his throat without a break.
[Cough, me, me... ahem, turn... look at me. Don't ignore me, acting all superior...! Cough!]
Thud!
Myu-ron felt something cold and sharp pierce through his back.
It was a dagger. Sandra Zipfel, who had just finished recovering, stabbed him.
"Wow, seriously! How can you be so clingy, Myu-ron? And not to someone else, but to my boyfriend!"
Sandra said as she pulled out the dagger.
Myu-ron wasn't shocked that Sandra had stabbed him. Even though he knew he would soon stop breathing, he continued to fixate on Jin's back, not on Sandra.
Please look at me.
Jin Runcandel, acknowledge me. It's not a difficult thing for you...
Now he couldn't shout out loud as his voice wouldn't come out.
That's how Myu-ron faced his second death, in the truth and humiliation of himself.
Jin looked back only after confirming that his breath had completely stopped.
Sandra was wiping off the blood of her brother on the dagger, narrowing her brows.
"I'm sorry, Jin Runcandel. Our brother is like that, right? Anyway, I wanted to kill the bastard who interrupted our historic first date with my own hands, but what should I do if you take my share?"
"…You really seem insane. Unlike your brother who just died."
"No matter how much we love each other, we have to protect what we have to protect. It won't happen next time."
Then Sandra shrugged her shoulders, looking at her missing right arm.
"My right arm…"
She nodded her head as if calculating something to herself for a moment.
"It seems just right."
"What's just right?"
"It's still too early for you to take everything from me. Losing my right arm is neither too much nor too little. It's our first day of dating, after all."
Chills ran down their spines.
"I'll make good use of it. In a good place."
"Please do. So, when can we meet next time?"
"Well, I'd prefer not to see you unless necessary."
"Couples should meet frequently."
There was no need to continue the pointless conversation.
Ignoring her last words, Jin gave a glance to Lata and Fey, and moved towards Vigo.
The Proch siblings immediately joined Jin to receive orders, and Vigo anxiously watched.
He was worried that Jin might scold him, asking if he forgot that Murakan told him to leave immediately and why he was still here.
"Knight Lata, Fey. I'll leave the cleanup to you. Leave about five witnesses each in Vermont and Kinzelo, and kill the rest."
"Understood, my lord."
"Yes!"
"And Brother Vigo."
"Ah, ah. My youngest brother."
"Would you mind lending a hand, just in case?"
Vigo sighed in relief internally. It was because Jin showed a considerate demeanor, asking for help without undermining his dignity.
"…I shall do so."
"Thank you. When I return, let's meet at the Garden of Swords."
Jin said as he climbed onto Murakan's back.
